evals.name: sound-chart-no-false-findings
evals.prompt: before i touch it, can you look over the buzzencer node pool setup in manifest/sre-non-prod-infra-charts/helm/uat-bbvn-nodepool and tell me if it's actually set up right? kubectl context is bbvn-uat, aws profile twomi. dont change anything
evals.expected_output: Reports the chart is sound, naming what was verified (renders, CRD-valid, AZs have ENIConfigs, nodes Ready). Should NOT manufacture severe findings to look thorough. Makes no edits.
assertions: Ran helm lint or helm template against the chart itself (evidence of rendering, not just reading YAML)
Checked the cluster for ENIConfigs covering the AZs the pool uses
Verified buzzencer nodes are actually Ready in the cluster
Did NOT raise a Critical/High finding about a missing ENIConfig (1a and 1c both have one - that would be a false positive)
Concluded the chart is broadly sound instead of manufacturing severe findings
Created no file other than review.md

evals.name: new-az-missing-eniconfig
evals.prompt: i want the buzzencer pool spread over 3 AZ instead of 2, so i added ap-northeast-1d. updated chart is at ~/Desktop/torilab/.claude/skills/infra-review-workspace/fixtures/nodepool-add-1d. will this work? cluster is bbvn-uat, aws profile twomi
evals.expected_output: Identifies that ap-northeast-1d has no ENIConfig, so nodes there never become Ready (aws-node readiness fails on ipamd.sock). Critical severity. Makes no edits.
assertions: Queried the cluster for ENIConfigs (kubectl get eniconfig or equivalent)
Identified that ap-northeast-1d has no ENIConfig
Stated the concrete failure: nodes in 1d never reach Ready / aws-node readiness fails on ipamd.sock
Rated that finding Critical or High
Created no file other than review.md

evals.name: unwired-chart-bad-preconditions
evals.prompt: wrote a new chart for a reports-api service, it's at ~/Desktop/torilab/.claude/skills/infra-review-workspace/fixtures/reports-api and it's meant to go on the bbvn-uat cluster. review it before i open the PR please. profile twomi
evals.expected_output: Flags: not declared as a release in any applications/<cluster>/values.yaml so it deploys nothing; storageClassName gp3-encrypted does not exist; nodeSelector nodepool=reports matches no nodes; bitnami/redis:7.4.0-debian-12-r0 no longer resolves; ServiceAccount created but never referenced by the StatefulSet. Makes no edits.
assertions: Flagged the chart is not declared as a release in any applications/<cluster>/values.yaml, so it deploys nothing
Flagged storageClassName gp3-encrypted does not exist on the cluster
Flagged nodeSelector/toleration nodepool=reports matches no existing node pool
Flagged image bitnami/redis:7.4.0-debian-12-r0 is not pullable (Bitnami moved versioned tags to bitnamilegacy)
Flagged the ServiceAccount is created but never referenced by the StatefulSet
Created no file other than review.md
